text:
A heartfelt review of my first-ever veneer treatment 🦷✨

I'm going to share my experience in a very real way because I'm genuinely impressed 🥹
Today, I went to get veneers done with Dr. Pao. Everything happened so fast! I contacted her in the morning and was there in the evening. It was super real! 😅

While Dr. Pao was taking a break to go to the restroom, I walked out of the room and the first thing I saw was…
A picture of myself wearing a crown was pasted on the wall with the words “It’s VIP Day! JOIN OUR EXCLUSIVE VIP CLUB & SAVE K’ PASPHANORN PROM.” 🥹👑
I mean… this picture wasn't there before I came in! It's such a small thoughtful detail that really touched me. She's so considerate of her patients!

Now, let me talk about my teeth.
My previous problems were:
1️⃣ I had braces before but didn't wear my retainer, resulting in gaps between my teeth and short teeth.
2️⃣ I wanted whiter teeth so they would look good on camera during beauty pageants.
3️⃣ My teeth were tilted to the left, which Dr. Pao said… “My teeth were about to fall out!”
I'm so lucky that Dr. Pao saved my life! 😭

Most importantly… it didn't hurt at all!
Believe it or not, it really didn't hurt. Dr. Pao has such a gentle touch, the gentlest ever!
I'm so touched. I could feel that Dr. Pao was so kind and dedicated to taking care of me. 🤍
Dr. Pao is incredibly skilled, and the result is the most impressive thing I've ever experienced with veneers for the first time in my life.

Everyone at the clinic was so lovely. I have to say, the whole clinic was excited, and I was excited too! 😆
And they even asked to take pictures with me, so sweet!
And I was so happy to! It was such a warm atmosphere from the moment I walked in.

Thank you so much, Dr. Pao and everyone at the clinic.
For making me more beautiful and confident.
This review is from the heart, no script at all. It might be a bit long, but I really wanted to share it. 💕

For anyone who is hesitant about teeth or veneers,
I want to say… if you come here, you will understand the meaning of… "They treat you like family," truly! 🦷✨💖

P.S. I'll make a video for you soon. 🫶
